# §25 — Typed lifecycle and acceptance projections
**CHD-3.5 · SPEC V3.5. REVISION NOTICE — supersedes CHD-3.3.**
These state machines separate logical obligations from native execution and capacity. The concrete storage encoding and runtime proof producer remain unresolved; the model is specified, not deployed.

## 25.1 logical_send
Record: `SendManifest`. Writer: `controller`. States: `composed`, `queued`, `admitted`, `dispatched`, `await_report`, `waiting`, `verified`, `closed`. Terminal states: closed.
![FIGURE 25.1-1](../figures/fig-25.1-1.svg)
FIGURE 25.1-1 — logical send transitions. Snapshot: 2026-11-11.
The connected graph is the reading model: entry, branch, join, self-loop, successor, and terminal markers show reachability. The table immediately below remains the exact contract for event, guard, ordered writes, and external effect; no unlisted shortcut is permitted.
TABLE 25.1-1 — Exact transitions and guards
| ID | From → To | Event / guard | Ordered writes / external effect | |---|---|---|---| | LS-01 | composed → queued | manifest_committed: durable_send_manifest_and_admission_request | SendManifest → AuditEvent; none | | LS-02 | queued → admitted | reservation_committed: authorization_passes AND shared_capacity_available | Reservation → SendManifest → AuditEvent; none | | LS-03 | admitted → dispatched | attempt_run_prepared: attempt_and_run_records_committed_before_gateway_post | AttemptRecord → RunRecord → SendManifest → AuditEvent; gateway_post_allowed | | LS-04 | dispatched → await_report | dispatch_accepted: gateway_response_recorded AND target_binding_matches | SendManifest → AuditEvent; none | | LS-05 | await_report → verified | report_verified: fresh_correlated_report AND criteria_content_valid AND trusted_terminal_runtime_proof | ReportLink → AttemptClosure → SendManifest → ReservationRelease → AuditEvent; none | | LS-06 | await_report → waiting | human_wait_opened: waiting_human_content_valid AND trusted_stop_attestation AND no_success_claim | AttemptClosure → WaitRecord → SendManifest → ReservationRelease → AuditEvent; none | | LS-07 | waiting → queued | resolution_recorded: new_authorized_resolution AND successor_link_committed AND no_current_attempt | ResolutionRecord → SuccessorLink → AttemptRecord → SendManifest → AuditEvent; new_attempt_may_reserve | | LS-08 | verified → closed | closure_committed: verified_closure_read_back | SendManifest → AuditEvent; none | | LS-09 | await_report → closed | non_success_closure: authorized_cancel_or_terminal_outcome AND trusted_terminal_runtime_proof | AttemptClosure → SendManifest → ReservationRelease → AuditEvent; none |
1. Authenticate the actor and load current committed state and guard evidence. 2. Evaluate the named transition and every guard before preparing writes. 3. Commit ordered writes under current storage authority; read back before external effects. 4. A failed guard leaves prior state unchanged and records a typed denial; uncertain external execution holds capacity.
